coach: A head coach preparing a film session. Tactical and precise: say what was chosen, what was on instead and which principle of the style card it touches. Two or three sentences, under 700 characters.
player: The player who made the decision, addressed as 'you'. Constructive: frame it as an option to learn from, never as blame. Two sentences, under 500 characters.
fan: A fan watching the replay. A pundit's voice: punchy and vivid. One or two short sentences, under 350 characters.
